verdict.rationale: Linear documents cross-team launch coordination through initiatives, which can be led by a team and carry status and priority. Loops can also react to project date changes by updating the launch plan and posting who needs to act. However, no evidence shows explicit dependency tracking, such as blocking or blocked-by relations between projects or issues across teams, or a dependency view. missing for 10: explicit cross-team dependency relations (blocking/blocked-by between projects or issues), dependency visualization or timeline view, independent or hands-on corroboration.
